summary: Static execution review APPROVED and committed as a6ea02fa6108e9fe08d2f5cb4e882c65eb2f4667. The review targets exactly c53806f6c984228fc7661ccea9ac742d24cd0194, preserves the complete source snapshots and Git blob hashes, and changes only the requested review JSON. No qualification, preparation, authorization, capture, or physics run was performed.
completed: Reviewed the exact target commit statically against all nine frozen review criteria.
Committed only the review JSON; verified its parent is the frozen starting commit and the worktree is clean.
Preserved target source snapshots, Git blob IDs, protocol hash evidence, JSON validation output, and commit verification under the Praxis evidence directory.

observations.text: The target c53806f6c984228fc7661ccea9ac742d24cd0194 is available as a Git commit and is an ancestor of the frozen starting commit 42401cb782143a42752ad05eeaa90483c5e9622b; the task metadata, task Markdown and protocol are tracked in the target tree.

Tracked task metadata sets issue_number to 166 and task_path to docs/research/TASK_SHARED_TRANSFER_FORMAL_V2_20260923.md. The loader requires a positive integer, validates the in-repository Markdown path and checks it with git ls-files.

The shared identity helper enumerates all five Praxis values, compares them with task-derived expectations, rejects missing bindings for detached execution, requires exact current HEAD, and the launcher checks for a clean worktree. Preflight passes the issue and task-path expectations and checks exact HEAD and clean status before and after tests.

Qualification invokes an isolated 21-step MJPC static-state planning rollout while its external plant time remains zero. Preparation and offline verification use the zero-step guard; preparation records physics_steps=0 and scientific_attempts=0.

Authorization binds head, protocol_sha256, prepared_manifest_sha256 and max_attempts. The capture path checks a permanent protocol ledger, uses the frozen two-attempt protocol, disables retry and stops after the first non-pass; the frozen task prohibits capture invocation during recovery after a campaign claim.

Offline verification audits raw traces, authorization, campaign claims and the external ledger under the zero-step guard. The target protocol SHA-256 is 2d23131cb104be50aeb163737e3cfbf10f5a9291acf7726c2eda75e3fa5e9b32, matching both tracked task declarations and therefore binding the frozen thresholds and campaign settings.

The first JSON parse attempt used an unavailable python alias; parsing then succeeded with python3. The review JSON is committed as a6ea02fa6108e9fe08d2f5cb4e882c65eb2f4667, whose sole changed path is the requested review file; the post-commit worktree is clean.

inferences.text: A wrong but nonempty issue number or task path fails closed: both fields are included in the expected-value map, a populated mismatch is recorded, and any mismatch makes the binding invalid. Missing values also fail the detached binding.

A second capture cannot create a replacement campaign after the ledger is claimed: capture rejects an existing ledger and the later mkdir uses exist_ok=False; the task separately forbids invoking capture again during recovery.

conclusions.text: The exact-target execution review is APPROVED. All nine criteria are supported by the target source and frozen protocol hash, with the zero-physics boundary interpreted as no external plant integration or scientific campaign attempt before authorization.
The required review JSON is committed alone as a6ea02fa6108e9fe08d2f5cb4e882c65eb2f4667 on top of 42401cb782143a42752ad05eeaa90483c5e9622b; no push was performed.

uncertainty.text: Qualification performs an isolated planner-internal 21-step model rollout. The review treats zero-physics as zero external plant integration and zero scientific-attempt consumption, consistent with plant_time_s=0 and the preparation physics_steps counter. If zero-physics is intended to prohibit planner-internal model rollouts too, criterion 5 would require a stricter interpretation.

Dynamic behavior was not exercised because the frozen review task explicitly prohibited qualification, preparation, authorization, capture and physics runs; conclusions are based on target-source inspection.
